The concrete has about 3-4 greys with a noisy speckle, and the dirt about 3-4 browns, against the paving reference's roughly 7 visible tones with stones shaded one by one. The cracks are thin pale lines, and the interior slab field is small and sparse. Overall it is thinner and less crafted than the Beodeul paving reference, so it fails on structure and shading depth, not on hue.
